findings.text: the declared measure says the four sol-family lanes plus spark resolve to two groups with a separate undeclared backend, but SOL_FAMILY_CONFIG reuses codex-terra as the undeclared backend; the asserted codex-main group therefore contains only codex, codex-astra and codex-luna, so the five-lane census only appears to be asserted and the manifest's claim that all five lanes resolve to two groups is false.

this 69-line figure is a fifth changed path outside the four exclusive write paths in prompt.txt; the graphics instruction did not transfer write scope, so the worker should have requested a scope change before adding it.

the figure labels codex-main as four lanes and the plan/evidence alt text says four codex lanes collapse into that wallet, but the diagram draws only three connectors and explicitly leaves codex-terra ungrouped; the visual record contradicts its own fixture.

the landed-record link uses the plan route /plan/reckon/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed instead of the typed evidence route /reckon/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed used by this repository, so the durable record is linked through the wrong resource surface.

GroupPosition declares observed_at as str or None, but group_position accepts epoch-number stamps and stores reading.get('observed_at') unchanged at line 154; the epoch test exercises that path without asserting the field type, leaving the public dataclass contract inconsistent with a supported input.
